the Draft Statement and the proposed regulations discussed therein do direct the Assistant Secretary -- Program Policy to provide "liaison" and "technical assistance" to other land responsible Federal agencies in an effort to coordinate ORRV regulation. Such "liaison" and "technical assistance", however, would appear likely to fall considerably short of the kind of close interagency cooperative effort which is necessary to obtain the joint regulatory approach which is necessary if agency actions are to be truly coordinated. We would suggest that the Executive Order can best be implemented by carrying forward the interagency task force approach followed in development of the Task Force Study in an effort to develop joint regulations implementing the Executive Order. We would, of course, anticipate that Interior would be the lead agency in this task force. If legislation is necessary to implement this approach, we would support such legislation.
V. The Department's Responsibilities Vis-a-Vis
State, Local Governments and Private Lands -
We note with approval the indication in the Draft
Statement that the Department intends to devote some effort
towards assisting states, local governments and private organizations and individuals in developing areas and facilities for
